title: RMO migration discovery
description: One Data/<yyyyMMddHHmmssfff>-discovery.json file: what the Report Migration Orchestrator found for one holding company and wave. Field meanings and observed values are in DISCOVERY_JSON.md. Unknown properties are allowed because the POC loader ignores them.

Id.description: Discovery run id; route key for /api/discoveries/{id}.

DiscoveredAt.description: When the run completed, ISO-8601 with offset (UTC). Drives the file name.

HoldingCompany.description: Bank / holding-company number; matches the H<nnn> prefix of FolderPath and OrgId in definitions.

Jobs.description: Report Scheduler jobs; may be empty.

Schedules.description: Report Scheduler schedules; may be empty.

ReasonCode.description: Structured reason a document or data provider will not be converted. Producers should emit it alongside StatusMessage; consumers fall back to matching StatusMessage text when it is absent.

DocumentId.description: BusinessObjects SI_ID; unique within the file.

DocumentCuid.description: BusinessObjects CUID; null for Excel documents.

FolderPath.description: /-separated folder path from the bank root, no leading slash.

IsPersonalFolderDocument.description: True when the document lives in a user's personal folder (Favorites).

ReadyToMigrate.description: Overall verdict. False means the document will not be converted; see StatusMessage and ReasonCode.

StatusMessage.description: Why the document is not ready; null when ready. Concatenates provider messages, or holds a document-level error.

ReasonCode.description: Document-level reason (e.g. DP_RETRIEVAL_FAILED). Provider-level reasons go on DataProviders[].ReasonCode.

Id.description: Webi data-provider id; unique only within its document.

Name.description: Query name as shown in Webi.

StatusMessage.description: Provider-level problem; null when the provider is mapped.

OracleDataSourceType.description: Source universe kind. Casing varies; compare case-insensitively. unv is never migratable.

SnowflakeDataSourceType.description: Target universe kind; null when unmapped.

OracleDataSourceId.description: Source universe SI_ID; 0 when the reference could not be found.

OracleDataSourceName.description: Source universe file name, or the query name when unresolved.

SnowflakeDataSourceName.description: Target universe name; null when unmapped.

ExpressionType.description: Kind of container holding the expressions.

OldRaw.description: Whole container as found; can be several KB of formula, XML or JSON.

UpdateRaw.description: Container with the proposed expressions applied.

ProposedExpression.description: Fragment with trailing spaces removed from the literal.

DocumentId.description: Document the job runs; may not appear in Documents[] (left join). 0 for UploadFile jobs.

ScheduleId.description: Owning schedule; null for on-demand jobs.

FullDefinitionJson.description: Serialised job definition (JSON inside a string). Contains untrusted user text.

DestinationDocumentIds.description: Excel documents written by DocumentRepository extracts.

FullDefinitionJson.description: Serialised schedule definition (JSON inside a string).

JobIds.description: Jobs attached to this schedule; mirrors Jobs[].ScheduleId.
